0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
2 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
3 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
4 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
6 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
7 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
8 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
9 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
10 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
12 empty ::=
13 remember ::=
14 stmtseq ::= empty
15 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
16 fullstmt ::= barestmt
17 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
18 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
19 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
20 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
21 sideff ::= expr
22 cont ::= empty
23 startsub ::=
24 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs
25 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs COLONATTR
26 attr ::= ATTRLIST
27 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
28 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
29 attrs ::= empty
30 attrs ::= attrs COLONATTR attr
31 attrs ::= attrs attr
32 attrlist ::= COLONATTR
33 optsiglist ::= empty
34 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
35 expr ::= expr ANDOP expr
36 expr ::= expr PLUGIN_LOGICAL_AND_LOW_OP expr
37 expr ::= expr OROP expr
38 expr ::= expr PLUGIN_LOGICAL_OR_LOW_OP expr
39 expr ::= listexpr
40 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
41 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
42 listexpr ::= term
43 termbinop ::= term PLUGIN_HIGH_OP term
44 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term

52 termbinop ::= term SHIFTOP term

54 termbinop ::= termeqop
55 termbinop ::= term BITANDOP term
56 termbinop ::= term BITOROP term
57 termbinop ::= term DOTDOT term
58 termbinop ::= term ANDAND term
59 termbinop ::= term PLUGIN_LOGICAL_AND_OP term
60 termbinop ::= term OROR term
61 termbinop ::= term PLUGIN_LOGICAL_OR_OP term
62 termbinop ::= term DORDOR term
63 termbinop ::= term MATCHOP term

65 termrelop ::= relopchain
66 termrelop ::= term NCRELOP term
67 termrelop ::= term PLUGIN_REL_OP term
68 relopchain ::= term CHRELOP term
69 relopchain ::= relopchain CHRELOP term
70 termeqop ::= eqopchain
71 termeqop ::= term NCEQOP term
72 eqopchain ::= term CHEQOP term
73 eqopchain ::= eqopchain CHEQOP term
74 termunop ::= PERLY_MINUS term
75 termunop ::= PERLY_PLUS term
76 termunop ::= PERLY_EXCLAMATION_MARK term
77 termunop ::= PERLY_TILDE term

79 termunop ::= term POSTDEC
80 termunop ::= PREINC term

93 term ::= LOOPEX term
94 term ::= NOTOP listexpr
95 term ::= UNIOP
96 term ::= UNIOP block
97 term ::= UNIOP term
98 term ::= KW_REQUIRE
99 term ::= KW_REQUIRE term
100 term ::= FUNC0
101 term ::= FUNC0 PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
102 term ::= FUNC0OP
103 term ::= FUNC0OP PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
104 term ::= FUNC1 PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
105 term ::= FUNC1 PERLY_PAREN_OPEN expr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
106 term ::= BAREWORD
107 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm attrlist
108 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm
109 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN myterm attrlist
110 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN term
111 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN expr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
112 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
113 myterm ::= scalar
114 myterm ::= hsh
